server_response_contract_comment: Server invoke is fire-and-forget. No assistant or probe reply text is expected back through the flow result. Terminal states must only communicate success or error.

validate_input_data.description: Declare the values entering from input_data and validate the required external flow inputs before internal steps run

assistant_mark_processing_started.description: Mark chat processing through the board control-plane before assistant dispatch

select_assistant.description: Normalize the incoming user text, detect the probe marker, and choose the downstream assistant

expr: data._isEchoProbe = $length(data._rawMessageText) >= (data._markerLen * 2) and $substring(data._rawMessageText, 0, data._markerLen) = data._marker and $substring(data._rawMessageText, $length(data._rawMessageText) - data._markerLen) = data._marker

data.chatCopilotTimeoutMs = ($parsePositiveInt := function($value) { ($type($value) = "number" and $value > 0) ? $floor($value) : (($type($value) = "string" and $count($match($trim($value), /^[0-9]+$/)) > 0 and $number($trim($value)) > 0) ? $floor($number($trim($value))) : null) }; $fallbackTimeout := $parsePositiveInt(expects_data.chatCopilotTimeoutMs); $fallbackTimeout ? $fallbackTimeout : 300000)

copilot_assistant.description: Run the Copilot-backed assistant logic, which persists its own assistant reply into chat storage
copilot_assistant.server_reply_contract_comment: No reply text is expected back from assistant.js. The assistant must write user-visible replies through chat store only and exit success or error.

argsMassaging.stdinTemplate: { 'boardId': boardId, 'cardId': cardId, 'logId': logId, 'turnId': turnId, 'baseRef': baseRef, 'aiWorkspaceRoot': aiWorkspaceRoot, 'boardSetupRoot': boardSetupRoot, 'cardStoreRef': cardStoreRef, 'scratchStoreRef': scratchStoreRef, 'chatFlowRoot': chatFlowRoot, 'watchPartyFilesForChatDir': watchPartyFilesForChatDir, 'chatCopilotTimeoutMs': chatCopilotTimeoutMs }

foundry_assistant.description: Run the Foundry-backed assistant logic, which persists its own assistant reply into chat storage via the same final-reply MCP path
foundry_assistant.server_reply_contract_comment: No reply text is expected back from foundry-chat/assistant.js. The assistant must write user-visible replies through the shared final-reply MCP tool and exit success or error.

argsMassaging.stdinTemplate: { 'boardId': boardId, 'cardId': cardId, 'logId': logId, 'turnId': turnId, 'baseRef': baseRef, 'aiWorkspaceRoot': aiWorkspaceRoot, 'boardSetupRoot': boardSetupRoot, 'cardStoreRef': cardStoreRef, 'scratchStoreRef': scratchStoreRef, 'chatFlowRoot': chatFlowRoot, 'watchPartyFilesForChatDir': watchPartyFilesForChatDir, 'chatCopilotTimeoutMs': chatCopilotTimeoutMs, 'foundryEndpoint': foundryEndpoint, 'foundryChatAgentId': foundryChatAgentId, 'foundryChatExposedMcpToolPrefixes': foundryChatExposedMcpToolPrefixes }

probe_assistant.description: Run the deterministic probe assistant logic, which stages its final reply through the shared final-response flow when refs are available
probe_assistant.server_reply_contract_comment: No reply text is expected back from probe.js. The probe must write the final user-visible reply through the shared final-response container flow and exit success or error.

argsMassaging.stdinTemplate: { 'boardId': boardId, 'baseRef': baseRef, 'aiWorkspaceRoot': aiWorkspaceRoot, 'cardStoreRef': cardStoreRef, 'cardId': cardId, 'logId': logId, 'scratchStoreRef': scratchStoreRef, 'turnId': turnId, 'userText': userText, 'watchPartyFilesForChatDir': watchPartyFilesForChatDir }

assistant_clear_processing.description: Clear processing through the runtime MCP controlplane after the assistant has already appended the final assistant reply

cleanup_failure.description: Write a failure system message before clearing processing through the control-plane

argsMassaging.bodyTemplate: { 'cardId': cardId, 'text': 'AI response failed - the assistant could not generate a reply. Check server configuration and logs.', 'turn': turnId, 'files': [] }

assistant_clear_processing_failed.description: Clear processing through the runtime MCP controlplane after a failed assistant run

completed.description: Chat flow completed successfully; no server reply payload is returned
completed.server_reply_contract_comment: This terminal state reports success only. No assistant reply text or artifacts are returned to the server response path.

failed.description: Chat flow failed; only the failure intent is returned
failed.server_reply_contract_comment: This terminal state reports failure only. No assistant reply text or artifacts are returned to the server response path.
